title: Particle Spear
body:
Syntax: perform particle spear <target>

Description: A Dust Release (Kekkei Tota) attack that strikes one target. An off-balance target loses Stamina over time.  Requires Dust Release (Kekkei Tota) and its revealed chakra natures, without a clan bloodline. Base damage: 10300-10700. 30% chance to inflict off balance. Unlocks at level 100. Costs 105 Chakra and 0 Stamina; 16 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
